RD-5 fails on timing and scope. The segment ran 14:28-14:34 [F3]; the driver's proposal came at 14:30 [F8] and the rider's answer at 14:31 [F9]. Consent must be the rider's message sent before the segment started, and on the face of the timestamps the agreement came after the deviation had already begun, so it is at best post-hoc notification, not pre-segment consent [RD-5]. Even setting timing aside, F8 named a specific road (round via Clementi Road) and the chat record is complete and timestamped [F10], but F3 carries no road names and nothing in the record places the car on Clementi Road; the driver's statement naming that road is a post-trip claim, not consent and not a record of the driven path [F11].
